ex.en: Older boys used to bully him on the school bus nearly every morning.
ex.zh: 年纪较大的男孩以前几乎每天早上都在校车上欺负他。

words.note: bully sb into doing sth；名词 bullying 指霸凌。

ex.en: The new computer chip is twice as fast as the old one.
ex.zh: 新计算机芯片的速度是旧芯片的两倍。

words.note: chip 指芯片、碎片；英式 chips 指薯条，美式称 fries。

ex.en: The town is famous for its well-preserved medieval walls and narrow streets.
ex.zh: 该镇以保存完好的中世纪城墙和狭窄街道闻名。

words.note: 也拼作 mediaeval；medi- 表「中间」，与 medium 同源。

ex.en: An oil tanker ran aground near the coast and leaked fuel into the sea.
ex.zh: 一艘油轮在近海搁浅，燃油泄漏入海。

words.note: tanker 指运油或运气的大型船；tank 是容器，注意区分。

ex.en: The job involves travelling abroad for several weeks each year.
ex.zh: 这份工作每年需要出国几周。

words.note: involve 后接动名词 doing；be involved in 表参与。

ex.en: The officer drew his pistol but did not fire a single shot.
ex.zh: 警官拔出枪，但没有开一枪。

words.note: pistol 指手枪，比 gun 具体；rifle 是步枪。

ex.en: Workers assemble the parts by hand before the final inspection.
ex.zh: 工人在最终检验前手工组装这些零件。

words.note: as- 表「向」，semble 表「同」；名词 assembly 表集会或装配。

ex.en: The lawyers built a watertight case that the defence could not challenge.
ex.zh: 律师们构建了无懈可击的案子，辩方无法质疑。

words.note: watertight 本指防水，引申指论证严密；airtight 也有此引申。

phr.en: the transition from A to B

ex.en: The country is still managing the transition from a rural to an urban economy.
ex.zh: 该国仍在应对从农村经济向城市经济的转变。

words.note: transition 后接 from...to...；也可直接作动词表转变。

ex.en: The spray is designed to repel insects without harming the plants.
ex.zh: 这种喷剂用来驱虫，而且不伤害植物。

words.note: re- 表「回」，pel 表「推」；repellent 指驱虫剂。

ex.en: He muttered something about the noise and closed the window.
ex.zh: 他嘟囔了几句关于噪音的话，关上了窗户。

words.note: mutter 指低声含糊地说；murmur 声音更柔和，注意区分。

ex.en: The council has announced a series of measures to cut traffic in the centre.
ex.zh: 市议会宣布了一系列减少市中心交通的措施。

words.note: series 单复数同形；a series of 后接可数名词复数。

ex.en: The application process is more complicated than the website suggests.
ex.zh: 申请流程比网站上说的要复杂。

words.note: complicated 指因环节多而复杂；complex 更中性，侧重结构。

ex.en: He cleared years of junk out of the garage in a single weekend.
ex.zh: 他用一个周末把车库里积了多年的废物清理干净。

words.note: junk 指无用的旧物；junk food 是固定说法，指垃圾食品。

ex.en: The tank holds a maximum of fifty litres of water.
ex.zh: 这个水箱最多可装五十升水。

words.note: maximum 反义为 minimum；作名词用 a maximum of + 数字。

ex.en: Small shops in the area have thrived since the new station opened.
ex.zh: 新车站开通后，这一带的小商店兴旺起来。

words.note: thrive 常搭配 on 或 in；形近词 strive 表努力。

ex.en: She came up with an imaginative solution that cost almost nothing.
ex.zh: 她想出了一个几乎不花钱的富有创意的方案。

words.note: imaginative 指有想象力；imaginary 表虚构的，容易混淆。

ex.en: Thousands of penguins gather on the ice to breed each winter.
ex.zh: 每年冬天成千上万只企鹅聚集在冰上繁殖。

words.note: penguin 是可数名词；群体用 a colony of penguins 表示。

ex.en: Each region is represented by two members on the national committee.
ex.zh: 每个地区在全国委员会中由两名成员代表。

words.note: represent 表代表或相当于；名词 representative 指代表。

ex.en: Critics consider the novel a literary masterpiece of the twentieth century.
ex.zh: 评论家认为这部小说是二十世纪的文学杰作。

words.note: masterpiece 由 master 加 piece 构成，指大师之作。

ex.en: Hundreds of students compete for a small number of places each year.
ex.zh: 每年数百名学生争夺为数不多的名额。

words.note: compete with sb for sth；名词是 competition。

ex.en: A tolerant society allows people to hold views we may disagree with.
ex.zh: 宽容的社会允许人们持有我们可能不同意的观点。

words.note: be tolerant of 表容忍；动词 tolerate，名词 tolerance。

ex.en: Rescue teams were dispatched to the area within an hour of the quake.
ex.zh: 地震发生后一小时内，救援队就被派往该地区。

words.note: dispatch 也可拼作 despatch；名词指派遣或急件。

ex.en: In an emergency, stay calm and call the number on the wall.
ex.zh: 紧急情况下要保持冷静，拨打墙上的号码。

words.note: emergency 常与介词 in 连用；emergency exit 指紧急出口。

ex.en: The room was lit only by a dim lamp in the corner.
ex.zh: 房间里只有角落一盏昏暗的灯照明。

words.note: dim 可指光线暗或记忆模糊；作动词表变暗。

ex.en: Heavy snow paralyzed traffic in the city for almost two days.
ex.zh: 大雪使该市交通瘫痪了将近两天。

words.note: 英式拼作 paralyse；be paralyzed with fear 表吓得发僵。

ex.en: Good interpersonal skills matter as much as technical knowledge in most jobs.
ex.zh: 大多数工作中，良好的人际交往能力和专业知识同样重要。

words.note: inter- 表「之间」，personal 表「人的」；多修饰 skills。

ex.en: Her exemplary behaviour during the crisis earned the respect of the whole staff.
ex.zh: 她在危机中的典范行为赢得了全体员工的尊敬。

words.note: exemplary 源自 example，指可作榜样的；副词为 exemplarily。

ex.en: The new professor was welcomed by the entire faculty at the meeting.
ex.zh: 新教授在会上受到全体教员的欢迎。

words.note: faculty 指院系或全体教员；表才智时用复数 faculties。

ex.en: The factory announced layoffs affecting nearly two hundred workers.
ex.zh: 工厂宣布裁员，近两百名工人受影响。

words.note: layoff 是名词，动词用 lay off sb，指解雇或临时停工。
